reason: My booking system already has an online booking button and clients use it. I can't see what a chat receptionist would add that justifies another monthly charge when I'm already counting every subscription.
objection: Another subscription on top of the booking system I already pay for, with no proof it brings in extra bookings instead of just answering questions I already handle.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial that shows, on my own bookings, that it brings in clients my current booking button misses.
